scope: Pinned Godot 4.8-beta2; Linux x86_64; headless reference; shared virtual host; no native/FPS or peak memory qualification. Paired quartiles describe sample dispersion, not confidence intervals.

packer.method: 64 real deflection dictionaries, 32 reference ticks each of Jensen Ugly Stik and P-51; warmup then 12 balanced groups of 200000 operations

recording.method: Original recorders and final corrected candidate in one process; 8 balanced pairs after warmup; 480-tick Jensen flight and actual 240-row family blocks; synthetic small and near-cap controls
